d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam easy bread recipe share kar raha hu, 5 minutes me ready ho jati hai agar chopping ho gaya hai to garlic, aur taste gazab hota hai, aap bhi try karna ye Homemade Garlic Bread, no oven recipe hai aur proper cafe style wala taste aata hai!
Recipe Garlic Bread in Tawa - No Oven Cafe Style
Ingredients:
Garlic - 1 tbsp (if using only hybrid use 2 tbsp)
Butter - 3 tbsp
Oil - 3 tbsp (heat really well)
Oregano Seasoning - 1/8 tsp
Salt - 1/8 tsp
